fact: TSA reports Algeria has officially launched the electronic public procurement portal under law 23-12 of 5 August 2023, where firms download tender documents free and submit bids.

The Algerian Finance Ministry officially launched an electronic public procurement portal on 23 December 2021 for the electronic distribution and exchange of procurement documents and information, with procurement to be dematerialised progressively.
